---
applyTo: "*.md,docs/**,plans/**"
---

Follow the [canonical policy](../../policy/core.md) and
[Copilot workflow](../../docs/copilot/workflow.md) together with applicable project instructions.

Keep the audience, requirements and actual behavior consistent. Update affected
links, interface/workflow diagrams and acceptance-to-evidence mapping. State pending,
blocked, failed and unexecuted checks explicitly. Preserve prior review records and
stricter local policy. Separate setup instructions, runtime observations, provider
advice and human approvals; document recovery without authorizing deployment.
Use existing formats and include source revisions when adopting outside patterns.
